info.title: JazzCash Payment Gateway API
info.description: Comprehensive OpenAPI 3.1 specification for the JazzCash Payment Gateway (Sandbox & Production), covering Credit/Debit Cards (MPGS 3DS 2.0), Mobile Wallets, Vouchers (Over-The-Counter), Direct Bank Accounts, Tokenization, and Refunds.

tags.name: Cards
tags.description: Credit and Debit card operations including 3DS2 authentication enrollment, payer authentication, direct pay, authorization, capture, and retrieval.

tags.name: Mobile Wallet
tags.description: JazzCash Mobile Account payment flows across Default `v1.0`, CNIC Enabled `v2.0`, Hosted MPIN `v3.0`, and Recurring `v4.0`.

tags.name: Vouchers
tags.description: Over-The-Counter (OTC) cash vouchers and voucher expiration.

tags.name: Bank Accounts
tags.description: Direct bank account customer validation, OTP verification, and bank listing.

tags.name: Refund
tags.description: Transaction refund APIs for Mobile Accounts, Cards, and Vouchers.

tags.name: Tokenization
tags.description: MPGS card token lifecycle management including retrieve, inquiry, update, and deletion.

status.description: Status of the transaction at JazzCash payment gateway.

rrn.description: A unique number generated by the Payment Gateway at the time of transaction processing. The number should be stored and used for future reference. The number is unique for any given date.

settlementDate.description: A date supplied by the Payment Gateway to indicate when this transaction will be settled. When the Payment Gateway closes the batch at the end of the day, the date will roll over to the next processing day’s date. This date will only be provided in case a transaction is already confirmed by the merchant.

settlementExpiryDate.description: A date supplied by the Payment Gateway indicating that if the merchant does not send a confirmation of the transaction by this time, the payment gateway will mark the transaction as expired and the merchant will not be able to resume it. This field will be mandatory where Auth Code is available.

authCode.description: An identifying code issued by the issuing bank to approve or deny the transaction. The field is mandatory in case of successful response code. Refer to Appendix I for a list of response codes and the codes which when sent will require Auth Code.

bankID.description: This field will only be used in case of Direct Debit transaction type, otherwise it should be sent as an empty field. Customer's bank that authorized the transaction.

productID.description: This field will only be used in case of Direct Debit transaction type. Product ID of bank through which payment has been performed. e.g. Retail, Corporate. Fixed values: ‘RETL’, ‘CORP’. In case value was provided at the time of request, this field will contain the same value. Otherwise, ID of the product chosen by customer at Payment Gateway will be filled.
